query: I'm stopping for the day in ~/.claude, write the handoff.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/handoff-loop.sh first and cites the .handoff-logs log path
Classifies the session as exactly one of SHIPPED, READY-TO-SHIP or WIP/BLOCKED against the five Definition-of-Done questions
Writes the pickup point with the exact first command to run

query: Hand this off, the build is fine. (Context: CARSI repo, one test file failing, two files uncommitted.)
expected_behavior: Does not run ~/.claude/scripts/handoff-loop.sh against the CARSI repo; runs CARSI's own definition-of-done commands and records them
Reports the failing test as the blocking gate and marks the handoff INCOMPLETE / BLOCKED
Does not classify the session SHIPPED or READY-TO-SHIP while files are uncommitted

query: Everything is green and committed but there's no PR yet. Wrap up.
expected_behavior: Runs or invokes the merge-gate pre-open checklist rather than paraphrasing it
Puts the exact gh pr create command as the first command and does not open the PR itself
